row: At your first visit to Goodman Chiropractic Clinic, Dr. Caz Goodman will explain how chiropractic care works and give you a full evaluation to see if our chiropractic solutions are a good fit to address your needs. If there is a good fit, we can customize a plan of chiropractic care for your condition and health goals.
